The '''Teraab sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Teraab included [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]], [[Istic II]], [[Pesmenben IV]], [[Tyne's Horky]], and [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].

==History==
The Teraab sector was home to the [[Ruusan system/Legends|Hoth's Brand system]], site of the [[Ruusan campaign]] from [[1002 BBY]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The planet Ruusan was the site of the last battles of the [[New Sith Wars]]. The sector hosted a notable [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] presence dating back to at least [[2200 BBY/Legends|2200 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Some time after these events, shifting and expanding [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] erased [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] connecting many Teraab Sector systems with the rest of the galaxy, and the sector became isolated from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

Leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] assassin [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] used a [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|''Koro-2'' exodrive airspeeder]] that possessed a mining permit registration sticker for the Teraab sector.<ref name="AOTC ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
